title: Tim Curry bought a $650K LA home in 1993; after his death, the $7.5M property found a buyer
summary_full: Tim Curry’s historic Los Feliz home has come under offer for $7.5 million, just hours after the actor’s death at 80. Curry bought the 1922-built property for $650,000 in 1993 and spent years restoring its original details. The Spanish-inspired residence was later owned by stars including Robert Pattinson, Jim Parsons and Aaron Paul.
